remarks:
A Home with Heart in Dunkirk

Imagine stepping into a classic one-and-a-half-story home that's been lovingly cared for for many years. This charming two-bedroom, one-bath residence is ready to welcome new owners to make their own memories and mark their place in the neighborhood.

As you approach the house, you'll notice its well-maintained metal siding and the inviting enclosed front porch. This is a perfect spot to settle in with your morning coffee, create a cozy reading nook, or greet visiting friends. Step inside, and you'll immediately notice the beautiful original woodwork that graces the interior, a testament to the quality craftsmanship of an earlier era. While the home does need some updating to bring it fully into the modern age, its solid bones and authentic character shine through. The newer windows flood the home with natural light and provide improved energy efficiency.

The layout includes one bedroom on the first floor and another bedroom upstairs, along with one full bathroom. This convenient floor plan offers comfortable living without unnecessary space. The one-car garage provides convenient parking and storage.

Situated on a larger city lot, this property offers more outdoor space than typical urban homes—perfect for gardening, outdoor projects, or simply enjoying extra breathing room in the neighborhood.

Being sold as-is, this home is ideal for buyers who appreciate real character and envision the potential in a property with good bones. 

This is more than just a house—it's a home waiting for its next chapter.
